notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Season of Growth.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Resolve the Season of Growth trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
